Title: Diagnosis of test `['org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.zip.Maven221MultiVolumeTest.testRead7ZipMultiVolumeArchiveForStream()']`
Details: The test `testRead7ZipMultiVolumeArchiveForStream` is checking the functionality of reading a 7Zip multi-volume archive for stream. The test sets up a scenario where it reads entries from the archive and expects a specific behavior when encountering a truncated entry. The failure is occurring at line 97, where the test is expecting to fail with a message of "shouldn't be able to read from truncated entry" but is not failing as expected.

1. The test reads entries from the archive using `zi.getNextEntry().getName()` in a loop and compares the entry names to an array of expected entry names.
2. It then reads the last entry from the archive and expects it to have a specific name.
3. After that, it attempts to read from a truncated entry by calling `zi.read(buffer)` in a loop until it reaches the end of the truncated entry.
4. The test expects this read operation to fail with an IOException and a specific message of "Truncated ZIP file".
5. Finally, the test tries to read another entry from the truncated file and expects this operation to fail as well.

The test failure indicates that the expected IOException with the message "Truncated ZIP file" is not being thrown as expected during the read operation on the truncated entry, leading to the test not failing where it should.

Next, I will analyze the code related to the reading operation on the truncated entry to identify the root cause of the failure.
